purpose: Teach: ディスカウント/映し出さ/敬遠/すみやか/追随/係員/きめる/くらべ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ディスカウントの頻度を下げましょう
lines.en: Let's reduce how often we run discounts.
lines.style: Measured, executive tone. Clear authority but not harsh. Opens with decision already formed—no room for debate, but inviting collaboration. Steady pace, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議室で資料が映し出される設備を更新します
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the meeting room equipment updated so we can display materials clearly.
lines.style: Prompt, affirming. Slight nod in the voice—showing he's already thinking through logistics. Professional but warm, not mechanical. Quick acceptance followed by concrete action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 敬遠されがちな新ブランドを再構築しましょう
lines.en: And let's rebuild our new brand—it's being overlooked and we need to change that.
lines.style: Calm, directive. Weight on the diagnosis (being overlooked) before the solution. Tone suggests this is important but not a crisis. Steady hand guiding the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。すみやかに対応窓口を設置します
lines.en: Yes. I'll set up a dedicated contact point to handle it right away.
lines.style: Efficient, reassuring. Voice stays lean—he's not over-explaining because the task is clear. Slight emphasis on 'right away' to show urgency is heard and accepted, not dismissed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界他社の追随を分析しましょう
lines.en: Next, let's analyze what our competitors are doing and how they're adapting.
lines.style: Thoughtful, strategic. Slower than the directives before—this signals it requires deeper work. Slight lift on 'analyze' to invite intellectual engagement, not just execution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コールセンター係員の研修を強化します
lines.en: Understood. We'll strengthen call center training so our staff can compete better.
lines.style: Assured, practical. Direct connection between problem and solution. Voice is experienced—he's not discovering this idea, he's confirming it's the right move. No flourish, just competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の価格をきめる会議を開きましょう
lines.en: Let's schedule a meeting to set the pricing on our new product line.
lines.style: Executive, forward-moving. Switches to logistics mode—this is the next checkpoint. Slight lift in energy compared to earlier lines, indicating a new phase of discussion. Brisk but not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。同業他社とくらべての強みを明確にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we clarify our competitive advantages compared to what others are offering.
lines.style: Closing tone, solid and grounded. Voice settles slightly—this is the landing point. Confident without arrogance. 'Competitive advantages' gets a light emphasis, showing he understands the stakes.
